Hello,

Wattlebird Freight Desk (ticket WAT-10477) requests a formal delivery review for consignment GLH-2209417 (Welshpool to Boulder Ridge Camp Stores, Kalgoorlie-Boulder, 14 crates, 612 kg).

Your scan feed shows DELIVERED 14 crates, 06 Oct 2026 14:02 AWST, Boulder Ridge dock 2, e-signature R HALDANE, geo ok (scan 88121702). The consignee's receiver has sent us a paper docket she says your driver left. It carries the handwritten note "Rcvd 11 of 14. 2 crates crushed (nos. 6, 9). 3 crates not on truck. Driver said he would chase.", signed R. Haldane 6/10, time written 4.40pm. She states the tablet battery was flat and that she did not sign the tablet. Your Kalgoorlie ops (Mick) has not yet seen this docket. A scanned copy is attached.

Please could you:
1. Review the e-POD (signature image, timestamp, geo data) against the paper docket.
2. Obtain driver 0417's account and the Kalgoorlie depot out-tally.
3. Check whether any GLH-2209417 crates remain at the Kalgoorlie depot or on the vehicle.
4. Note the reported damage to crates 6 and 9.

Please reply with a review reference and the date we can expect your finding. The cargo insurer needs a written basis from us by Mon 12 Oct 2026, so a reference by 17:00 AWST Fri 9 Oct would help.

This is a request for review, not an allegation and not a claim lodgement.

Regards,
Wattlebird Freight Desk

Hello Tobias,

Thank you for the update. Here is where things stand.

Goldfields' system records all 14 crates as delivered. Boulder Ridge's signed paper note says 11 arrived, two of them damaged. Your insurer, Ironbark, has told us it will not open a claim while those two records disagree. Today we have formally asked Goldfields' Perth head office, which handles their claims, to review the delivery and give us a reference.

We cannot yet give you a credit note or a claim number. Neither has been issued, and we won't promise one until Goldfields or Ironbark confirms it. We will update you as soon as Goldfields replies.

It would help if you could forward the Welshpool photo of the 14 crates loaded on 4 Oct, with the time it was taken if you have it, so we can add it to the review.

Regards,
Wattlebird Freight Desk
